summary: This bill requires the federal government to reimburse state and local governments and school districts for their own funds used to keep Head Start and Early Head Start programs running during a federal government shutdown.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly addresses the Head Start and Early Head Start programs, which are federal education initiatives. By ensuring reimbursement for state and local funds used to maintain these programs during a government shutdown, it aims to protect their continuity and funding, thus supporting public education programs.
